protocol.gate_rule: per tensor, over the 9 cross pairs vs the trusted same-arm pool (3 pri_i-pri_j + 3 off_i-off_j): (a) bias = the elementwise mean of the signed cross-pair difference - a deterministic (algebraic) error survives pair-averaging while atomic scatter cancels - bounded in both max-element (<= 5.0x) and L2 (<= 5.0x) form against the same statistics on the trusted pool; the L2 form is the sensitive one (a proportional error of eps shows up as bias_l2_ratio ~ eps/noise_rel); (b) tail_ratio = max single-pair max|difference| ratio, <= 3.0, the gross-anomaly statistic. The trusted pool is never inflated by an H8 run; its max (not median) is used because the same-arm difference distribution is heavy-tailed. If the gate fails while the on-arm's own scatter exceeds 5.0x the trusted floor the result is reported INCONCLUSIVE_ELEVATED_H8_SCATTER rather than FAIL_SEMANTICS
protocol.boundary_gate_rule: means2d_raw / conics_raw carry moments in H8 mode, so they are gated by reconstruction with the same two statistics: reconstructed(on_j) vs raw(off_i) over 9 cross pairs against a reference pool of the same quantity in both representations (3 off_i-off_j direct pairs + 3 reconstruct(on_i) - reconstruct(on_j) pairs). The direct-adjoint floor of the raw buffer is reported for context but is not the tolerance: the moments' intermediate magnitudes (~1e3x the adjoint) set the reconstruction's own fp32 noise
